validation.name: interior scalar envelope
validation.source:
from fractions import Fraction
U={13:45,14:50,15:55,16:60,17:68}
caps=[U[17-s]+9*s+s*s//4 for s in range(5)]
assert caps==[68,69,74,79,85]
def floor_new(q):
    a=85-q
    return max([0,a-79]+[s+1 for s in range(5) if a>caps[s]])
strict_q=[]
checks=0
improved=0
for q in range(36):
    a=85-q
    lo=floor_new(q)
    old=max(0,6-q)
    assert lo>=old
    assert 18*lo<=2*a
    if lo>old: strict_q.append(q)
    for s in range(5):
        if s<lo: assert a>caps[s] or s<a-79
        checks+=1
    for E in range(18):
        for connected in [False,True]:
            low=max(int(connected),lo)
            if E<=17:
                vals=[Fraction(2*a-low*z,18-z) for z in range(E+1)]
                assert vals==sorted(vals)
                oldcap=min(13,(2*a-old*E)//(18-E))
                newcap=min(13,44-q,(2*a-low*E)//(18-E))
                assert newcap<=oldcap
                improved+=newcap<oldcap
                checks+=1
assert strict_q==list(range(3,17))
for q,E,old,new in [(4,4,11,10),(5,8,13,12),(10,4,10,9)]:
    assert min(13,(170-2*q-max(0,6-q)*E)//(18-E))==old
    assert min(13,44-q,(170-2*q-floor_new(q)*E)//(18-E))==new
print({'checks':checks,'strictly_improved_q':strict_q,'improved_overlap_scalar_cells_including_connected_variants':improved,'small_degree_caps':caps,'status':'PASS'})

validation.name: fixed connected leaf witness
fixed two-connectivity boundary witness
validation.source:
from itertools import combinations
residues={1,2,4,8,9,13,15,16}
V=list(range(18))
edge={frozenset((i,j)) for i,j in combinations(range(17),2) if (i-j)%17 in residues}
edge.add(frozenset((0,17)))
def adj(i,j): return frozenset((i,j)) in edge
assert len(edge)==69
assert not any(all(adj(i,j) for i,j in combinations(S,2)) for S in combinations(V,4))
I4=[S for S in combinations(V,4) if all(not adj(i,j) for i,j in combinations(S,2))]
assert I4 and all(17 in S for S in I4)
assert not any(all(not adj(i,j) for i,j in combinations(S,2)) for S in combinations(V,5))
print({'status':'PASS','fixed_graph':'Paley17 plus leaf','n':18,'edges':69,'I4_count':len(I4),'all_I4_contain_leaf':True,'scope':'isolated A only'})
